title: Sunday showdown: Three candidates face off on GBC
subtitle: The first debate of the 2026 elections featured three candidates on the Grupo Bandeirantes stage
excerpt: On Sunday (23), three presidential candidates participated in the first debate hosted by GBC. Other activities included political rallies, religious events, and an interview.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On Sunday morning (23), three presidential candidates participated in the first presidential debate of the 2026 elections, hosted by Grupo Bandeirantes de Communication.

In addition to the debate, the day featured political and religious events, a press conference, and studying. Four candidates had no public agenda this Sunday.

With information from Agência Brasil.
